purpose: Primary-source Germany V9 first-pass evidence. Direct/ad-hoc tariffs are kept separate from contract/card/roaming products; third-party station prices are discovery-only unless independently confirmed by the pricing authority.

SWLB_MOBILITAET.aliasNote: SWLB (Ludwigsburg-Kornwestheim) is distinct from the previously processed SWL identity for Stadtwerke Lübeck Energie GmbH; do not collapse these aliases.

primaryEvidence.finding: Official SWLB LadeApp price sheet valid from 2025-07-01 explicitly publishes Ad hoc – Direktbezahlfunktion prices at SWLB Mobilität charging stations: AC 0.59 EUR/kWh, AC-Parkhaus 0.49 EUR/kWh, DC 0.79 EUR/kWh. Standing fee: AC 0.08 EUR/min from minute 241 capped at 12 EUR; DC 0.10 EUR/min from minute 46 capped at 20 EUR; standing fees apply daily 08:00-20:00 and not in SWLB park garages. QR direct charging remains possible without the SWLB LadeApp. Prices include VAT.
Official 2026 SWLB communications identify subsidiary SWLB Mobilität GmbH as the entity continuing public charging-infrastructure expansion, supporting the current operating authority/brand mapping.

SWLB_MOBILITAET.scopeRule: Preserve the official AC / AC-Parkhaus / DC classes and standing-fee windows; do not flatten AC parking-garage pricing into ordinary AC.

primaryEvidence.finding: Official SWBB public-charging surface confirms SWBB charging infrastructure and continued network expansion.

Official SWBB e-mobility price sheet valid from 2025-02-01 publishes own-station prices for the SWBB Ladekarte/eMobility-App product: AC 0.5950 EUR/kWh plus 0.0595 EUR/min after 240 min capped at 14.28 EUR; DC 0.7140 EUR/kWh plus 0.0595 EUR/min after 60 min capped at 14.28 EUR. These values are contract/card/app pricing and are not promoted to ad-hoc direct payment.

discoveryEvidence.finding: Multiple current SWBB stations indicate ad-hoc web/app/RFID capability but do not provide a verifiable current direct-payment price; other stations differ in reported payment methods. Used only to establish station/payment heterogeneity.

SWBB.reason: Current official numeric pricing found is explicitly the SWBB card/app product, not an authoritative contract-free QR/web checkout tariff. No network-wide direct price is inferred.
SWBB.neededToComplete: Obtain an official current QR/web/card direct checkout for representative SWBB EVSEs or an official station-level ad-hoc tariff table/feed, then map payment-method-specific prices to EVSEs.

authorityRelations: Team Emobility GmbH currently technically operates Stadtwerke Göppingen public charging infrastructure according to official EVF/Stadtwerke communications.
Stadtwerke Göppingen and Energieversorgung Filstal (EVF) are retained as infrastructure/source/legacy-brand relations, not asserted as the same legal entity.

primaryEvidence.finding: Official EVF communication dated 2026-06-10 states Stadtwerke Göppingen expanded public charging at Barbarossa-Thermen; direct charging without prior registration is possible by credit/debit card, while Team Emobility card and TEcharge app are also supported. It states Team Emobility GmbH technically operates Stadtwerke Göppingen charging infrastructure.
Current official EVF mobility page states Göppingen charging stations are operated by partner Team Emobility GmbH.
Older official EVF material from 2021 published 0.38 EUR/kWh AC and 0.48 EUR/kWh DC direct charging; retained only as historical evidence and explicitly not reused as current 2026 pricing.

discoveryEvidence.finding: Several Team Emobility HUB AC sites currently surface 0.50 EUR/kWh and a Göppingen DC clue around 0.60 EUR/kWh, but these values are not backed by a current official pricing authority across all EVSEs and therefore are not generalized.

TEAM_EMOBILITY_GOEPPINGEN.reason: Official 2026 evidence confirms contract-free card payment and current operating authority, but no current official station/EVSE-level numeric direct tariff table was found. Historical and third-party values remain non-authoritative clues only.
TEAM_EMOBILITY_GOEPPINGEN.neededToComplete: Resolve a current official Team Emobility/TEcharge/direct-card checkout or tariff feed mapped to Team Emobility-operated EVSEs, including AC/DC and any site-specific standing/session fees.
